cell_line.evidence: SEPN1 KO, ERO1 KO and DKO HeLa cells were described elsewhere.
HEK 293T cells were transfected with ERO1-Lα CRISPR-Cas9 KO plasmids (SC-401747 for human Santa Cruz Biotechnology).
WT and SEPN1 KD C2C12 were described elsewhere.

cell_type.evidence: Myoblast samples from three SEPN1-RM patients carrying null or missense SEPN1 mutations (P1 to P3, mutations detailed in Table S2) were included in this study.

Primary myoblast cultures were further enriched for CD56 surface marker via FACS and were maintained in collagen coated plates and myogenic cell culture medium containing DMEM/F10 (50:50), 20% FBS, 2.5 ng·mL−1 fibroblast growth factor 2 (FGF-2 also known as bFGF) and 1% penicillin–streptomycin.

disease_state.evidence: SEPN1-related myopathy depends on the oxidoreductase ERO1 alpha and is druggable with the chemical chaperone TUDCA

tissue.evidence: Myoblasts were obtained from diagnostic muscle biopsies or from surgically-discarded tissues obtained during therapeutic procedures (scoliosis corrective surgery) from patients homozygous or compound heterozygous for SEPN1 mutations by genomic DNA sequencing (SEPN1-RM) and from gender- and age-paired healthy individuals (controls).
